name: features-editorial
title: Editorial features
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: A large heading and intro that stay in view beside a ruled list of offers, each with a title, a sentence or two and an optional label.

meta.useWhen: Services or offers need a sentence each, and reading them in order matters more than visual variety.
meta.avoidWhen: There are only one or two items, or each needs an image. Use alternating-rows.
